answer: Locks are written down in velvet, expire in wharf, and river lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 28 aliases thus needs 87 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3540 identities would post 1787 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
